title: Binance, 29 October 2026
attribution: TraderTraitor (North Korea), per the FBI alert of 31 October 2026

reported.stolen_usd_source: Elliptic, 3 November 2026 (Binance put affected user funds at 6.34 billion)

timeline.what: A Wallet DevOps engineer installs a tampered Homebrew package, found through a search ad while looking for an AI coding tool.
A second engineer runs an interview 'assignment' from a fake recruiter. It replaces pyenv in the Homebrew directory with a backdoor.
Through the second engineer's machine and an internal AI tool, the attacker takes over two more engineers' computers and finds a token with container deployment rights.
Hours before the drain, a container deployed with stolen credentials reaches the wallet signing service. It signs what the attacker asks, including 50 EIP-7702 delegations.
The drain begins on the XRP Ledger: 233.46 million XRP leave five hot wallets in four minutes.
Ethereum and Bitcoin follow. 18,270 BTC is split across 19 addresses within half an hour.
Tether freezes the stolen USDT on Ethereum, 37 minutes after it arrived. 434 million USDT had already been swapped for ETH.
The last transfer, 2,961.9 ETH. The delegations had kept working after withdrawals were suspended.
The FBI attributes the theft to TraderTraitor and publishes 628 addresses.
